arguments.command:
python -c "
from glom import Fill, glom

# Test Fill with missing key
target = {'a': 1}
spec = {'a': 'a', 'b': Fill(0)}
result = glom(target, spec)
print('Fill result:', result)
assert result == {'a': 1, 'b': 0}, f'Expected {{\"a\": 1, \"b\": 0}}, got {result}'

# Test Fill with existing key (should use the value from target)
target2 = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
result2 = glom(target2, spec)
print('Fill result2:', result2)
assert result2 == {'a': 1, 'b': 2}, f'Expected {{\"a\": 1, \"b\": 2}}, got {result2}'

# Test Fill with nested path that exists
target3 = {'a': 1, 'b': {'c': 3}}
spec3 = {'a': 'a', 'b': Fill(0)}
result3 = glom(target3, spec3)
print('Fill result3:', result3)

print('All tests passed!')
"
